impact: CLAUDE.md describes a .env.deploy-based deployment configuration, but deploy.sh currently hardcodes remote user, host, and path. Future deployment work needs to resolve the source of truth without exposing secrets.
resolution: Resolved by documenting deploy.sh as the source of truth, clarifying that .env.deploy is not sourced, and adding safe deploy checklist guidance without exposing private host or secret values.
title: Deployment docs and deploy script disagree on configuration source
